title: A first look at ‘Our Fault: London,’ the ‘Your Fault: London’ and 'My Fault: London' sequel coming to Prime Video in 2027
summary: Asha Banks and Matthew Broome return for the concluding chapter of the English-language adaptation of Mercedes Ron's 'Culpables' trilogy.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Our Fault: London


, the sequel to


Your Fault: London


and


My Fault: London


, is coming to Prime Video in 2027.


- Asha Banks and Matthew Broome will reprise their roles as Noah and Nick.


- The film is the conclusion of English-language adaptation of Mercedes Ron's


Culpables


trilogy.


---


Prime Video has released first look images of


Our Fault: London,


the highly anticipated conclusion of Nick and Noah's love story.


It will be the third movie in the British adaptation of author Mercedes Ron's best-selling


Culpables


trilogy, following breakout hits


[Your Fault: London](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/your-fault-london-prime-video)


and


My Fault: London.


[A first look at ‘Love Me Love Me 2,’ the sequel coming to Prime Video in 2027](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/love-me-love-me-2-sequel-prime-video)


The film is the second installment of the saga based on Stefania S.'s international best-selling novels.


The news was revealed at the


Obsessed Retreat: Class of '26


event on September 8, which spotlighted Prime Video's biggest-ever young adult (YA) slate, with a focus on non-English language international Originals, which have consistently been the platform's most popular titles globally.


Our Fault: London


is part of that YA slate. Here’s everything you need to know about the upcoming movie which is coming to Prime Video in 2027.


## What is ‘Our Fault: London’ about?


Adapting the last book in Ron's trilogy,


Culpa Nuestra,


Nick and Noah have gone their separate ways after the heartbreaking end that left them in pieces. Noah moved away to Spain to take her mind off Nick, and Nick buried himself in his work.


When they’re forced to come together at Lion and Jenna’s wedding, the love they harbored for each other comes rushing back. They have no choice but to face reality. Is a future together an impossibility after all they went through, or is their love stronger than any challenge they’ve faced?


## How to watch ‘Our Fault: London’ on Prime Video?


Our Fault: London


will release exclusively on Prime Video in 2027 in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. An exact release date is yet to be announced.


Prime Video is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) , which costs $14.99 monthly or $139 annually in the U.S. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and


[qualifying government assistance recipients](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) at 50% off. Check your local Amazon website for information on Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a


[30-day free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


## Who is in the ‘Our Fault: London’ cast?


Reprising their roles from the previous movies are:


- Asha Banks (


[A Good Girl’s Guide to Murder )](https://www.amazon.com/Good-Girls-Guide-Murder/dp/B0FXZKKN2N/ref=sr_1_9?crid=26ZWGS67QE4GI&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.iHGQ8hWSRo_Q99qpPxTEvweCOSe3jPryip1phPHDt4uhTwcXoNXONu7UX0NOoDMSJgLOsAVfPw0lfkAJMS37jfyf7FsRdVAKxSYCVYL88aasa9tqR4n_dKUe2GeihtLUD4iIFr5vRzEH2uYqee7rTwSV775lOq0X__3hdOZRRhEpHN4CvDBlliJU4xfX_KZwWJCimBFtRLJUQDHpvix3nIbehKJgxqn7pE-aAFtZLEM.vw_nafbiDYkV2ulUveNkHWp3L1P4p2nOSWsu2UEw1pQ&dib_tag=se&keywords=a+good+girls+guide+to+murder&qid=1776074058&sprefix=a+good+girls+guide+to+murd%2Caps%2C199&sr=8-9) as Noah


- Matthew Broome (


[The Buccaneers](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt21108774/) ) as Nick


- Eve Macklin as Ella


- Ray Fearon as William


- Enva Lewis as Jenna


- Kerim Hassan as Lion


- Louisa Binder as Sophia


- Joel Nankervis as Michael


- Christina Cole as Bethan


Joining the cast of the third film is Hamish Frew as Simon, a new workplace acquaintance of Noah's, and John Hewson as Luca, Lion's brother.


## Who made 'Our Fault: London'?


The movie is directed by Chanya Button and produced by 42’s Ben Pugh and Erica Steinberg.


My Fault: London


and


Your Fault: London


directors, Dani Girdwood and Charlotte Fassler, serve as executive producers.


## How can I watch ‘My Fault: London’ and 'Your Fault: London'?


Our Fault: London


is part of the continuation of the collaboration between Prime Video and author Ron, known as


The House of Ron


, following the success of the


[Culpables trilogy](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-to-know-about-the-culpables-trilogy) ,


[which has reached over 100 million viewers worldwide](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/culpables-international-originals-viewing-figures-prime-video) .


It is the sequel to


[My Fault: London](https://www.amazon.com/My-Fault-London-Charlotte-Fassler/dp/B0DPZZP1QG/ref=sr_1_2?crid=16PJ059NBUYPB&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.a9WDbZYCoQCw8ogKpNo3ly8NvWGnQBSvfPAJd92F6AxOKAIJCNhCWRPGNjFok8pBhVfUxSpTJsRTHbW7Zz-bYfJd1SLLTn0FZML1JsSnJ4CF12LBIsRB7YWpTQStM1HDSFhupttLMsZgvah0B-kPaYiDlgEGrDhrPodXnjfmxXhzsj9uJtTnDX9J_AzaSLcOjSDYhaqW1okDVWl3MF7_4IuaOhO47rnTVMVGqg74374.lZWcaMYbkbMTMPN0XLK4H7CkrWU1bCMeQeUDP7yQWIc&dib_tag=se&keywords=your+fault+london&qid=1788448574&sprefix=your+fault+londo%2Caps%2C229&sr=8-2)


and


[Your Fault: London](https://www.amazon.com/Your-Fault-London-Charlotte-Fassler/dp/B0GXLJCS4Z/ref=sr_1_1?crid=16PJ059NBUYPB&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.a9WDbZYCoQCw8ogKpNo3ly8NvWGnQBSvfPAJd92F6AxOKAIJCNhCWRPGNjFok8pBhVfUxSpTJsRTHbW7Zz-bYfJd1SLLTn0FZML1JsSnJ4CF12LBIsRB7YWpTQStM1HDSFhupttLMsZgvah0B-kPaYiDlgEGrDhrPodXnjfmxXhzsj9uJtTnDX9J_AzaSLcOjSDYhaqW1okDVWl3MF7_4IuaOhO47rnTVMVGqg74374.lZWcaMYbkbMTMPN0XLK4H7CkrWU1bCMeQeUDP7yQWIc&dib_tag=se&keywords=your+fault+london&qid=1788448574&sprefix=your+fault+londo%2Caps%2C229&sr=8-1) , which are both available to watch now on Prime Video around the world.


Premiering on the platform in February 2025,


My Fault: London


adapted


Culpa Mía,


the first instalment in Ron’s beloved book series.


Your Fault: London


adapted the second book in that series,


Culpa Tuya,


releasing on Prime Video in June 2026.
